title: 第12章 伊芙琳的利益（求月票）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

散会后许景川直奔署长办公室。

他原本打算用魏雄案让自己在署里站稳脚跟，但现在明摆着魏雄背后有保护伞发力，自然得三思而行。

许景川怀疑周川把审讯陈洪和高洋一事交给自己是用心险恶。

自己要是审不出什么，就是办事不力、能力堪忧；真审出什么，那魏雄背后的保护伞会放过自己吗？

所以他想要确定周川在会上说的伊芙琳对此案的态度是真是假。

这决定了他如何去办这个案子。

“咚咚咚！”许景川敲响门。

“进。”

他推开门大步入内。

“署长好。”

“什么事？”正在看文件的伊芙琳抬起头来，不咸不淡的问道。

许景川关上门，快步上前敬了一礼说道：“署长，周组长将审讯陈洪和高洋的任务交给了我，属下初入职经验尚浅，特来向您请教。”

他说话时目光不由自主的从长官那两团沉甸甸的脂肪上飞快扫过。

伊芙琳的胸很大、很圆，警服扣得很严实，不露分毫，但正因如此轮廓鼓鼓囊囊的更加明显，引人遐想。

“警长先生，工作上有什么不懂的你应该直接去问你的直管上级，而非是冒失的来浪费我的时间。

怎么，莫非你以为我每天坐在办公室里不用出外勤就很闲吗？”伊芙琳神色很不耐烦，话里更是带刺。

她昨晚刚和丈夫吵了一架。

刘元又被人灭了口。

心情本来就不佳。

许景川这个破坏了她人事安排的家伙还来烦她，自然不会给好脸色。

许景川面不改色，“署长，我想这个问题只有您才能为属下解答。”

“哦？”伊芙琳听闻此言还真产生了点好奇心，敲了敲桌面，“说吧。”

“周组长说署长您下了死命令不管魏雄案背后有多大的人物，都要揪出来绳之以法，属下想知道署长对此有多大的决心。”许景川坦然直言。

伊芙琳怔住，随后一副被气笑了的模样，“你怀疑我只是装装样子？”

“属下不敢。”许景川微微低头表示歉意和恭敬，诚恳的说道：“只是属下是西城警署的人，是您的人。

害怕不明情况下失了分寸，万一因此给署里和您带来不必要的麻烦，那就罪过了。”

伊芙琳神色缓和了下来，微眯起眼睛饶有兴致的打量着许景川。

许景川始终保持恭敬的模样。

“听起来你很有信心能办好这个案子。”伊芙琳神色平静的说道。

许景川掷地有声道：“署长想要什么样的结果，我就能给出什么样的结果！一切全凭您的心意！”

“你很聪明，还很自信，胆子也很大，Goodboy，我已经开始有点喜欢你了。”伊芙琳突然展颜一笑。

旋即又迅速收敛笑容，神色变得冷峻严肃，“我明确告诉你，这案子不管背后是谁，都难逃法律严惩！

你放开手去查，捅出再大的窟窿有我给你补，只是我希望你的本事和你的胆子一样大，尽快有所突破。”

看着她正气凛然的嘴里。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After the meeting, Xu Jingchuan went straight to the director's office.

He originally planned to use Wei Xiong's case to gain a foothold in the agency, but now that it is clear that Wei Xiong has a protective umbrella behind him, he naturally has to think twice.

Xu Jingchuan suspected that Zhou Chuan had sinister intentions in entrusting him with the interrogation of Chen Hong and Gao Yang.

If he can't find anything in the investigation, he is ineffective and his ability is worrying; if he really finds something in the investigation, will the protective umbrella behind Wei Xiong let him go?

So he wanted to confirm whether what Zhou Chuan said at the meeting about Evelin's attitude towards the case was true or false.

This determines how he handles the case.

"Dong dong dong!" Xu Jingchuan knocked on the door.

"Come in."

He pushed open the door and stepped inside.

"Hello, Director."

"What's the matter?" Evelin, who was reading the document, raised her head and asked calmly.

Xu Jingchuan closed the door, stepped forward quickly, saluted and said, "Director, Team Leader Zhou has given me the task of interrogating Chen Hong and Gao Yang. My subordinate has little experience in joining the company, so I am here to ask for your advice."

As he spoke, his eyes involuntarily swept over the officer's two heavy lumps of fat.

Evelin's breasts were very big and round, and her police uniform was tightly buttoned so that nothing was exposed, but because of this, the bulging outlines were even more obvious, attracting people's imagination.

"Mr. Sheriff, if there is anything you don't understand at work, you should ask your immediate superior directly instead of wasting my time recklessly.

Why, do you think I am free just sitting in the office every day without having to go out to work?"Evelin looked very impatient, and her words were even more thorny.

She had just had a fight with her husband last night.

Liu Yuan was silenced again.

The mood was already bad.

If Xu Jingchuan, the guy who ruined her personnel arrangements, came to bother her, he would naturally not look down upon her.

Xu Jingchuan's expression remained unchanged, "Director, I think only you can answer this question for your subordinates."

"Oh?" Evelin actually became a little curious after hearing this, and knocked on the table, "Tell me."

"Team Leader Zhou said that Director, you gave a death order, no matter how big the person behind Wei Xiong's case is, they must be found out and brought to justice. I want to know how determined the Director is about this." Xu Jingchuan said frankly.

Evelin was stunned, then looked like she was angry and laughed, "Do you suspect that I'm just pretending?"

"I don't dare." Xu Jingchuan bowed his head slightly to express apology and respect, and said sincerely: "It's just that I am from the Xicheng Police Department and yours.

I am afraid of losing my sense of proportion under unknown circumstances. If this causes unnecessary trouble to the department and you, it would be a sin."

Evelin's expression softened, and she narrowed her eyes slightly and looked at Xu Jingchuan with interest.

Xu Jingchuan always maintained a respectful look.

"It sounds like you are very confident that you can handle this case." Evelin said calmly.

Xu Jingchuan said loudly: "Whatever result the director wants, I can give you! Everything depends on your wishes!"

"You are very smart, very confident, and very courageous. Goodboy, I have begun to like you a little bit." Evelin suddenly smiled.

Immediately, he quickly stopped smiling and his expression became cold and serious, "I tell you clearly, no matter who is behind this case, they will not escape severe legal punishment!

Go ahead and check it out. No matter how big the hole is, I will fill it for you. But I hope your ability is as great as your courage and you can make a breakthrough as soon as possible."

Look at her righteous mouth.
